method: Separate agent re-checked every sentence against the GED Assessment Guide / formula sheet and standard math

number-sense.notes: All math correct (exponent rules, 2^-2 = 1/4, fractional exponent, roots, |a - b|, -8 to 15 = 23, GCF 6 / LCM 36 for 12 and 18, undefined at x = 5, scientific notation). Summary is prose and matches the cards. Test claim 'the first few questions are answered without a calculator' is not in ag.txt (it says only that the calculator is provided for 'most of the items'); ged.com could not be reached (HTTP 503) to confirm the position of the non-calculator items.
fixes: summary[0] last sentence: replace 'On the GED test the first few questions are answered without a calculator, so these skills need to work by hand as well.' with 'On the GED test a calculator is provided for most questions, but not all of them, so these skills need to work by hand as well.'

ratios-percents.notes: Math correct: unit rate, proportion, percent to decimal, percent change formula, I = Prt matches formula sheet (I = interest, P = principal, r = rate, t = time), price x (1 + tax) / (1 - discount), scale area grows by factor squared, commission. Summary prose consistent with cards. Claim 'These are among the most common real-life questions on the GED Mathematical Reasoning test' is a frequency claim not supported by ag.txt (which gives no per-topic frequency; it only lists Q.3 targets incl. tips, commissions, percent increase/decrease).
fixes: summary[0] second sentence: replace 'These are among the most common real-life questions on the GED Mathematical Reasoning test.' with 'The GED assessment targets name real-world percent problems such as tips, commissions, and percent increase and decrease.'

geometry-2d.notes: All formulas match the formula sheet (square, rectangle, parallelogram, triangle, trapezoid, circle A = pi r^2, C = 2 pi r or pi d, pi ~ 3.14, a^2 + b^2 = c^2). Radius 5 row: 78.5 and 31.4 correct. Working-backward formulas and triples correct. Summary prose consistent. Minor style: 'measured straight up from the base' could read 'measured straight up from the base, at a right angle to it' but is acceptable plain English.

geometry-3d.notes: Rectangular prism, right prism (SA = ph + 2B, V = Bh), cylinder, pyramid (SA = 1/2 ps + B, V = 1/3 Bh), cone (SA = pi r s + pi r^2, V = 1/3 pi r^2 h), sphere (SA = 4 pi r^2, V = 4/3 pi r^3) all match the formula sheet. 'Formula sheet lists all of these formulas' is true. One-third rule, units, composite volume correct.

data-statistics.notes: Mean/median definitions match the formula sheet wording. Mode, range, box plot (middle half, IQR), weighted average, missing-value method, counting principle, 6x5x4 = 120, C(7,3) = 35, independent events, complement all correct. Summary prose consistent with cards and compare table.

expressions-polynomials.notes: Like terms, distributive property, -3(2x - 5) = -6x + 15, FOIL, (a - b)^2, trinomial factoring rule, difference of squares, rational expressions (cancel factors not terms) all correct. Summary prose consistent.

linear-equations.notes: Balance method, reciprocal for fraction coefficients, literal equations, substitution and elimination correct. d = rt matches formula sheet. Systems by substitution/elimination within assessment target A.2.d. Summary prose consistent.

inequalities.notes: Sign-flip rule (only multiply/divide by a negative), open/closed circles, shading, key words, rounding direction, testing values all correct. Summary and compare table consistent.

quadratics.notes: Standard form and quadratic formula match the formula sheet (y = ax^2 + bx + c; x = [-b +/- sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)]/2a). Zero product, square-root method, context examples (w(w+4) = 96 gives w = 8; n(n+1) = 132 gives n = 11; h = -16t^2 + 64t) valid. Summary prose consistent.

graphs-functions.notes: Math all correct: slope formula, y = mx + b, point-slope form match the formula sheet; quadrants, parallel/perpendicular (2/3 and -3/2, product -1), function definition, key features consistent with A.5/A.7 targets. Figure alt/caption match the image and cards. Claim 'It is the largest part of the algebra questions on the GED test' is not supported by ag.txt (it gives only 45% quantitative / 55% algebraic, no per-topic share); the site's own examWeight is not an official figure.
fixes: summary[0] second sentence: replace 'It is the largest part of the algebra questions on the GED test.' with 'Many of the algebra targets in the GED assessment guide involve graphs and functions.'
